I set up a three-node k3s cluster on old office desktops for our robotics society so members could run simulation jobs without fighting over one laptop.

Our robotics society needed somewhere to run simulation jobs other than one shared laptop, so three old office desktops became a three-node k3s cluster.

I wrote the containerd proxy fix. The other members ran their jobs on it.

documents.text:
Dear Graphcore hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Cloud Platform Engineer 2027 role at Graphcore.

Mira set up a three-node k3s cluster on old office desktops for our robotics society. The other members ran their jobs on it.

Pods could not pull images for a whole week; it turned out to be the university proxy settings missing from containerd, and we fixed it in the end. I wrote the containerd proxy fix.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ellie
